# Visa-Seva

> Fictional hackathon prototype; not an official Government of India service. Never use real personal, passport, payment, or document data.

## Primary tasks
- [Find my visa](/find/q/1): Six questions that produce a conservative, sourced suggestion of the likely visa path.
- [Start or resume](/start): The only place a demo application is created, and where a saved draft is picked up again.
- [Track an application](/track): Look up a demo application using its application ID and access code.
- [Documents and requirements](/requirements): What each visa route asks for, readable before starting anything.
- [Before you travel](/before-you-travel): Arrival readiness: what to carry, which ports accept an e-Visa, and what the e-Arrival Card is.
- [Help](/help): Common questions, a plain-language glossary, and the real official contacts.

## Reviewer entry point
- [Demo scenarios](/demo): deterministic records for draft, processing, documents-required, granted, and refused states.

## Agent documentation
- [Complete agent interface](/agent.md): routes, actions, fields, state model, finder inputs, safety boundaries, and official sources.

Ruleset 1.0.0; official sources reviewed 2026-08-26.
